body.value: 寺　百十七ヶ寺
寺（てら）百十七ヶ寺（ひゃくじゅうななかじ）

Temples: 117 Buddhist temples. Rightmost column of the leaf and part of Mibu's (壬生藩) religious-institution register, since it lies right of the ○三日月藩 marker. Label 寺 at y1018-1080; value 百(1437-1498) 十(1521-1581) 七(1605-1665) ヶ(1696-1735) 寺(1773-1834). The 十 is a plain cross (not 千) and the order is 百-十-七, so 117, not 170.
寺
僧　八十四人
僧（そう）八十四人（はちじゅうよにん）

Buddhist clergy: 84 persons. Label 僧 at y1016-1079; value 八(1436-1495) 十(1521-1580) 四(1608-1662) 人(1688-1748). The 八 splays with a gap at the top and the 人 strokes touch at the apex. Validated by the 内 split printed below: 男七十五人 + 女九人 = 84. Two faint marks at y995-1005 above the label are facing-page bleed-through (min gray 57/101 against this glyph's 13), not the 丷 of 曾 — every other label on the leaf starts flush at y1016-1018 with nothing above it — so they are excluded from the box.
僧
男七十五人
男（おとこ）七十五人（しちじゅうごにん）

Of the 84 clergy, 75 are male. This is the right-hand sub-column of the 内 split under 僧 (male right, female left); its top is level with the female run. The 七 shows the horizontal stroke and hooked vertical that distinguish it from 九. 75 + 9 = 84 ✓.
僧男
女九人
女（おんな）九人（きゅうにん）

Of the 84 clergy, 9 are female. The LEFT sub-column of the 内 split under 僧, ink x2440-2491, sharing top y1771 with the male run but only three glyphs deep: 女(1771-1817) 九(1839-1886) 人(1909-1953). The 九 has the rounded bending leg (not 七). 9 + 75 = 84 ✓. The box stops at y1960: the raw bbox ran to y2098 only because the male 人's stroke tip crosses ~1px left of the column divider at y2086-2091.
僧女
尼　四人
尼（あま）四人（よにん）
Nuns: 4 persons. Label 尼 at y1017-1076; value 四(1439-1494) 人(1519-1578). Counted separately from the 84 僧 in the adjacent column. Mibu's, being right of the ○三日月藩 marker.
尼
社　七十八社
社（やしろ）七十八社（しちじゅうはっしゃ）

Shrines: 78 Shinto shrines. Part of Mibu's (壬生藩) religious-institution register — it lies right of the ○三日月藩 marker, so by the right-to-left rule it belongs to the previous domain. Label 社 at y1017-1077; value 七(1268-1330) 十(1354-1416) 八(1439-1494) 社(1521-1578) — the 八 splays with a clear gap at the top, and this column's value begins higher on the leaf than its neighbours'.

修驗　六戸　人口二十五人
修験（しゅげん）六戸（ろっこ）人口二十五人（じんこうにじゅうごにん）

Shugen (yamabushi mountain ascetics): 6 households, population 25. The two-glyph label 修驗 sits at the top right of the column, and the value runs slightly to its left. The split below gives 男十一人 + 女十四人 = 25 ✓.
修驗
男十一人
男（おとこ）十一人（じゅういちにん）

Of the 25 shugen-household people, 11 are male. RIGHT sub-column of the 内 split under 修驗 (male right, female left), ink x2085-2137, shared top y2023: 男 十 一 人. The two sub-columns merge in projection, so the divider was set at the empirical profile minimum, x2084 (8 inked rows against ~70 either side). 11 + 14 = 25 ✓.

女（おんな）十四人（じゅうよにん）

Of the 25 shugen-household people, 14 are female — more women than men, consistent with these being household populations rather than clergy headcounts. LEFT sub-column of the 内 split under 修驗, ink x2032-2084, shared top y2023, four glyphs deep to y2275: 女 十 四 人. 14 + 11 = 25 ✓.

鉦打　六戸　人口十人
鉦打（かねうち）六戸（ろっこ）人口十人（じんこうじゅうにん）

Gong-beaters (itinerant nenbutsu mendicants who beat a small 鉦): 6 households, population 10. The population figure is exactly four glyphs, 人口十人, and ends well above the six-glyph 人口二十五人 of the parallel 修驗 column; the 十 is a plain cross with no slanted top stroke. The split below gives 男七人 + 女三人 = 10 ✓.

男七人
男（おとこ）七人（しちにん）

Of the 10 gong-beater household people, 7 are male. RIGHT sub-column of the 内 split under 鉦打, ink x1952-2000, shared top y1856: 男 七 人. The 七 is unambiguous at 7x (horizontal stroke plus hooked vertical). 7 + 3 = 10 ✓.

女（おんな）三人（さんにん）
Of the 10 gong-beater household people, 3 are female. This is the left-hand sub-column of the 内 split under 鉦打, level at the top with the male run: 女, 三 (three clean horizontals), 人. 3 + 7 = 10 ✓.

（以下二行欄外朱書）
（以下二行、欄外朱書＝いかにぎょう、らんがいしゅしょ）

Editorial note from the 1928 movable-type reprint: 'the following two lines stood in red ink in the margin [of the manuscript].' Not data. A complete paren pair of its own, ︵(y1014-1038) 以 下 二 行 欄 外 朱 書 ︶(y1450-1471), ink x1861-1924. The 'two lines' it refers to are the next two columns to its left — （兵隊十二小隊〔一隊三十人〕 and 合三百六十人）— which are wrapped by a SECOND paren pair that opens atop the 兵隊 column and closes below 合三百六十人, spanning both. The box's left edge is set at the measured ink minimum x1864; only the anti-aliased tip of the 兵隊 column's opening paren falls outside.
以下二行欄外朱書
（兵隊十二小隊
（兵隊（へいたい）十二小隊（じゅうにしょうたい）

Troops: 12 companies (shōtai). Mibu's standing army, entered in red ink in the manuscript margin per the note in the adjacent column. Ink x1791-1865: ︵(y1014-1029) 兵(1038-1093) 隊(1101-1162) 十(1188-1247) 二(1256-1288) 小(1356-1410) 隊(1442-1500). The opening parenthesis belongs to this column but its closing partner sits two columns left, below 合三百六十人 — one pair wrapping the whole 'two lines'. The per-company strength is given in the warichu immediately below (一隊三十人 = 30), and 12 x 30 = 360 matches the printed total exactly.
兵隊（欄外朱書）
一隊三十人
一隊（いったい）三十人（さんじゅうにん）

Each company: 30 men. A warichu (double-column inline note) inside the 兵隊 line — read RIGHT sub-column first: RIGHT x1826-1873 一(y1540-1548) 隊(y1592-1636); LEFT x1772-1821 三(y1527-1564, three horizontals) 十(y1590-1636) 人(y1659-1701). Boxed separately from its parent 兵隊 column because the warichu is 101px wide against the parent column's 72px and reaches under the （以下二行欄外朱書）footprint, which ends at y1471 — the two are vertically disjoint, so separate boxes are the only overlap-free enclosure. 12 companies x 30 = 360 ✓.
兵隊一隊人員
合三百六十人）
合（あわせて）三百六十人（さんびゃくろくじゅうにん）

Total: 360 troops. The second of the two red-ink marginal lines. Ink x1657-1728: 合(y1181-1242) 三(1269-1322) 百(1350-1412) 六(1433-1493) 十(1519-1577) 人(1601-1659), followed by the CLOSING parenthesis ︶ at y1667-1681, x1657-1721 — which closes the pair opened atop the 兵隊 column two columns to the right, confirming that one bracket wraps both marginal lines. Arithmetic closes exactly: 12 companies x 30 men = 360 ✓.
兵隊合計
○三日月藩
○三日月藩（みかづきはん）— 藩境を示す丸印つき藩名

Domain-boundary marker ○三日月藩 (Mikazuki, a 15,000-koku Mori-house domain in Harima). The only marker on the leaf. Ink x1505-1595: ○(y1352-1429) 三(1464-1534) 日(1592-1666) 月(1722-1804) 藩(1855-1937). It is the pivot for the whole page: everything to its RIGHT (x1650-2678) is the PREVIOUS domain, Mibu (壬生藩), whose block ends here; everything to its LEFT (x957-1470) is Mikazuki's, whose block starts here and continues on the facing 75R.
○三日月藩
高　壹萬五千石
高（たか）壱万五千石（いちまんごせんごく）

Assessed yield (kokudaka): 15,000 koku. Mikazuki's official omotedaka, the first column left of its ○ marker. Label 高 at y1008-1071; value 壹(1178-1240) 萬(1264-1325) 五(1350-1405) 千(1433-1489) 石(1518-1578). The 千 clearly carries the slanted ノ stroke on top, so it is 1,000 and not 十 — the classic x100 trap. Matches the Mori house's known Mikazuki assessment.
高（三日月藩分）
外ニ　高　五百六十石四斗八升七合　新開地
外に（ほかに）高（たか）五百六十石四斗八升七合（ごひゃくろくじゅうこくよんとはっしょうななごう）新開地（しんかいち）

In addition: 560.487 koku of newly opened land (新開地) — a supplement to the 15,000-koku main assessment. The small 外ニ prefix is printed as a right-side gloss (x1328-1374, y1165-1269) beside the main run (x1235-1319): 高(y1177-1241), 五(1353-1405) 百(1433-1493) 六(1516-1575) 十(1601-1661) 石(1685-1745) 四(1771-1825) 斗(1851-1912) 八(1939-1994) 升(2023-2082) 七(2106-2166) 合(2189-2250), then 新(2360-2420) 開(2443-2502) 地(2530-2587). Sub-units run strictly descending 石 > 斗(.1) > 升(.01) > 合(.001) ✓ = 560 + 0.4 + 0.08 + 0.007. The box encloses the offset 外ニ prefix together with its value, which is why it is wider than a normal column.
外二（三日月藩分）
正租　米　七千四百九十八石一斗九合五勺四才
正租（せいそ）米（こめ）七千四百九十八石一斗九合五勺四才（ななせんよんひゃくきゅうじゅうはちこく…）

Main land tax (shōso), rice component: 7,498.10954 koku. 正租 is the group label heading both this column and the 大豆 column to its left. The 升 place is skipped (= 0), so the figure is 7,498 + 0.1 + 0.009 + 0.0005 + 0.00004 koku.
正租米（三日月藩分）
大豆　千三百九十七石八斗九升六勺
大豆（だいず）千三百九十七石八斗九升六勺（せんさんびゃくきゅうじゅうななこく…）

Main land tax (正租), soybean component: 1,397.8906 koku. The column has no label of its own: 正租 heads the 米 column to its right and governs both. The 合 place is skipped (= 0), so the figure is 1,397 + 0.8 + 0.09 + 0.0006 koku. The final glyph is 勺, identical in shape to the 五勺 of the rice column and level with it; the rice column then has one more glyph, 四才, which this column lacks. So 六勺 = 0.0006 koku.
正租大豆（三日月藩分）

百二十五（ひゃくにじゅうご）＝一二五頁
